feature_config.window_rule: observed rows with cycles in [max(1, cutoff-29), cutoff]

protocol.direction: both negative and positive for each magnitude
protocol.application: multiply one sensor channel by 1+relative_change on observed feature-window rows only
protocol.evaluation_value: raw, unclipped RUL prediction change in cycles
protocol.candidate_scope: frozen P06 development models; no fitting, tuning, or official-test labels
protocol.constant_baseline_role: unchanged-input control; it has no sensor-dependent inputs

limitations: FD001 is simulated data and these 20 engines are development validation holdouts.
Changes are artificial relative shifts, not measurement-noise estimates or plausible failure interventions.
Prediction movement is conditional on frozen model fits; it is not accuracy, confidence, a causal effect, or a maintenance recommendation.
The constant-mean baseline is included only as an unchanged-input control.
